name: Howmet Aerospace
bullCase: Howmet Aerospace is the sole approved supplier for titanium fan blades and aluminum structural castings on every major western jetliner. This FAA certification barrier means Boeing and Airbus cannot multi-source critical airframe components. With aviation at record passenger levels and a 10-year production backlog, Howmet is compounding earnings at 15%+ with no margin ceiling.
bearCase: Defense/commercial aerospace spending is a long-cycle business. Any Boeing production halt, supply chain disruption, or airline capacity rationalization has multi-year revenue implications. The 5.7x leverage from prior private equity era constrains financial flexibility.
